settings.text: Find answers to the most common questions we receive. If you don't see your question, don't hesitate to reach out to us.

settings.heading: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.row_content: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), PayPal, and other secure online payment options available at checkout.

settings.heading: How can I track my order?
settings.row_content: Once your order is confirmed, we'll send you a tracking number by email. You can use it to monitor your shipment and get real-time updates on its delivery progress.

settings.heading: Are your pet products safe?
settings.row_content: Absolutely. All products in our store are carefully selected with your pet's safety as the top priority. We only carry items made from pet-safe, non-toxic materials. If you have specific concerns about a product, feel free to contact us.

settings.heading: What is your return and exchange policy?
settings.row_content: We want you to be completely satisfied with your purchase. If you're not happy with your order for any reason, you can initiate a return or exchange within 30 days of receiving the product. Please ensure items are unused and in original packaging.

settings.heading: Do you offer free shipping?
settings.row_content: Yes! We offer free shipping on qualifying orders. Please check our shipping policy page for full details on thresholds and estimated delivery times.

settings.heading: I'm not sure which product is right for my pet — can you help?
settings.row_content: Of course! We'd love to help you find the perfect match for your furry friend. Reach out to us via our contact page and tell us a little about your pet — breed, size, age — and we'll point you in the right direction.

settings.text: Didn't find what you were looking for? Feel free to contact us — we're always happy to help.
